description: Add a new field to a collection

collection_slug.description: The slug of the collection to add the field to

options.description: Field-specific options (e.g. { repeatable: true } for group fields). For richtext: { editor: { type: 1, outputFormat: 'html' | 'markdown' } }. For relation: { relation: { collection: <target collection id, slug, or name>, type: 1 | 2 }, includeDraft?: boolean } (1 = one-to-one, 2 = one-to-many).

parent_field_id.description: Internal ID of a group field to nest this field under

type.description: Field type: text, number, richtext, boolean, date, media, relation, select, longtext, group, etc.

validations.description: Validation rules (e.g. { required: { status: true, message: 'Required' } })

name: create_field
title: Create Field
